reference_outputs.title: Add /health endpoint
reference_outputs.description: Exposes an unauthenticated `GET /health` returning `{"status": "ok"}`, so a load balancer or orchestrator can probe the API without credentials. The check is static — it reports nothing about downstream dependencies.

reference_outputs.title: Return null for empty or invalid numeric input
reference_outputs.description: `parseNumber` no longer reports `NaN` as a parsed value: it trims its input and returns `null` for anything empty or unparseable, making the failure explicit to callers. `parseQuantity` absorbs that by falling back to `0`, so its own contract is unchanged.
reference_outputs.commit_message: fix: make parseNumber return null for invalid input

reference_outputs.title: Extract currency normalization helper
reference_outputs.description: Currency cleanup and supported-currency validation move out of `create_order` into a `_normalize_currency` helper, so the same rules can be applied from other entry points. Behavior is unchanged.

reference_outputs.title: Document local dev and linting commands
reference_outputs.description: The README's development section now names the actual commands (`npm install`, `npm run dev`, `npm run lint`) rather than describing the steps, so a new contributor does not have to infer them from package.json.
reference_outputs.commit_message: docs: update README dev and linting steps

reference_outputs.title: Accept % and + in email local-part
reference_outputs.description: `EMAIL_REGEX` rejected addresses containing `%` or `+`, so subaddressed emails failed validation. Both characters are added to the local-part class; everything else about the validation is unchanged.
reference_outputs.commit_message: (ABC-123) fix: allow % and + in email regex

reference_outputs.title: Treat timezone-less timestamps as UTC in toUtcIso
reference_outputs.description: A timestamp with no `Z` or numeric offset was parsed as local time, so the same input produced different instants depending on the server's timezone. `toUtcIso` now appends `Z` before parsing, and returns `null` for empty input. Unit tests cover the timezone-less case.

reference_outputs.title: Guard against a deleted user in notifyUser
reference_outputs.description: `notifyUser` crashed with a TypeError when `getUser` returned null for a deleted account. It now throws an explicit error naming the userId, and only sends the email once the user is known to exist.
reference_outputs.commit_message: ACME-512 fix: guard against null user in notifyUser

reference_outputs.title: Add configurable HTTP retries and fix two client bugs
reference_outputs.description:
Adds opt-in retries for transient upstream failures, and fixes two unrelated defects found in the same client.

**Key Changes:**
- `ApiClient.get` retries 502/503/504 with exponential backoff, bounded by the new `max_retries` (default `0`, so existing callers are unaffected).
- `close()` is now idempotent instead of raising on a second call.
- Pagination stops on a page without `next_cursor` rather than raising `KeyError`.

reference_outputs.title: Raise worker task timeout to 300s
reference_outputs.description: Raises `TASK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` from 60 to 300, so long-running tasks are no longer abandoned mid-flight.
reference_outputs.commit_message: chore: raise worker task timeout to 300s
